FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Aspen Ridge Pipelines Inc.
REPORTED BY
Pipeline patrol contractor
RECEIVED VIA
Phone call (on-call write-up)
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Called in from patrol near Gretna MB. At approx 1100 May 26 spotted crude oil on the ground at
tank site. Called ops, they said meter shows 78.0 m³ synthetic crude released. Tank still open, oil
leaking from flange on outlet line. Temp was -12°C overnight, possible frozen valve or seal. Crew
on scene said they tested the line at 0800 and didn't catch the leak then. No signs of third-party
damage, looks like internal issue with valve or gasket.
Patrol contractor - J. Vos
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
